name: Better-T-Stack
architecture: SvelteKit web app, Hono server with oRPC, Postgres through Drizzle, Better Auth, Polar only when the brief needs payments. Name the tables, routes, auth rules and how each requirement is met.
build: Run the scaffold only when the workspace is empty, then build inside apps/ and packages/. Add a health route if none exists. Never hand-write what the scaffold generates. To prove a screen works, run the app and capture it with: bun studio-kit/tools/screenshot.ts --url <url> --out <file.png>, from the Backroom root at the path given in your task. For a signed-in page, sign in through the app's API and pass the session with --cookie name=value.
review: Check authorization on every server route, input validation at the oRPC boundary, server-owned prices, secrets only from the environment, and Polar webhook signatures when payments are used. For every live check, run bash <Backroom root>/studio-kit/tools/review-env.sh <workspace> up (or status to reuse it). It creates a disposable committed-source copy, Postgres, API and web services and signs up a fictional owner and normal user; use its JSON URLs, credentials, DATABASE_URL and restart commands. Keep this JSON private, never paste credentials or generated secrets into findings or chat. Use down after review. Do not improvise a database or use builder services. A check that cannot run is BLOCKED with its reason, never FAIL; return review <round> <sha> blocked when environment limits prevent completion. Judge code scope against the frozen sources and the ordered plan-owner clarifications; neither builder conversation nor builder reports are evidence.
test: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; pnpm check-types; pnpm test:ci, which runs the tests on a disposable local Postgres exactly as CI does (pnpm test only if the project has no test:ci script)
scaffold: pnpm dlx create-better-t-stack@latest <project> --frontend svelte --backend hono --runtime node --api orpc --database postgres --orm drizzle --auth better-auth --payments polar --db-setup none --package-manager pnpm --addons turborepo oxlint --examples none --web-deploy none --server-deploy none --git --install
